modules.module_title: Prepare for cleaning and sanitation activities

pcs.pc_description: prepare and implement sanitation schedules for all work areas (e.g., workstation, canteen, washrooms, labs, offices, warehouses, outdoor premises)
communicate clear instructions to sanitation workers and ensure their understanding of daily tasks
identify and procure the required materials (e.g., tools, equipment, chemicals) for effective cleaning operations
select appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) for each task and ensure proper distribution to sanitation staff
ensure sanitation workers are equipped with necessary cleaning agents, tools, and equipment before starting tasks
allocate manpower efficiently for cleaning various surfaces and equipment (e.g., floors, fixtures, furniture, glass surfaces, and bins)
inspect cleaning tools and equipment regularly for operational effectiveness
report any shortages or malfunctions in cleaning materials or equipment to the relevant department
prepare cleaning solutions as per surface type and safety standards, ensuring safe handling and handover to staff
maintain records of cleaning activities, materials used, and time schedules, submitting accurate reports to management
prepare and provide chemical solutions to sanitation workers, as necessary
maintain optimal inventory levels of cleaning supplies, PPE, and chemicals
ensure chemicals are securely stored in designated locations, away from food processing areas
record and update procedures, policies, equipment lists, and relevant sanitation details, as required
monitor the use of chemicals, ensuring adherence to safety data sheets for effective cleaning

modules.module_title: Train staff and ensure safety compliance

pcs.pc_description: conduct regular training sessions and workshops on Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), and emerging hygiene standards, to enhance sanitation workers' skills and adherence to safety protocols
ensure all staff consistently wear PPE and follow standard hygiene practices to uphold food safety and quality standards
check the delivery and condition of cleaning equipment and supplies
check the accuracy of documentation, including inventory schedules and product labels
ensure the proper storage of tools and chemicals and take corrective actions to address any deviations
